notes: Every ship system is a part now: gunner, engineer, damage-control and navigator stations that have to be manned, magazines and autoloaders for ballistic guns (which hit harder), capacitors for energy guns, decoy launchers, ECM, repair drones, autopilot, coolant pumps, escape pods, lockers, fabricator, lift, galley, washroom, respawn pod, oxygen tank, tractor beam, mining laser, salvage arm, wings, fins and control surfaces that change flight in air, more tanks, gear and batteries. The hologram shows what a part will connect to and what it changes, auto-connects it, and warns about heat, exhaust, blocked guns, doors without floors and thrust off balance.
